Pursue a system design project (e.g. a scalable cache, message queue, or multi-tenant API) that showcases your ability to architect for reliability and scaling, then add it to your resume.
final_resume.growth_note: Your profile shows strong full-stack and operational skills (Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, testing), but the JD explicitly requires 2+ years of system design and architecture experience, plus demonstrated expertise in algorithms and design patterns. Your current bullets focus on implementation and deployment rather than architectural decisions or algorithmic problem-solving. To be competitive for SDE II, gain and document experience in system design, scalability trade-offs, and algorithm optimization.
